demonstrated_definition: True means the capability has source support plus generated-artifact, automated-test or local real-browser evidence. It does not mean that the public site has been verified. Publication remains false until the exact deployed GitHub Pages candidate passes the terminal publication journey.

evidence: Weighted names, identifiers, alternatives and bounded typo correction with explanations
Exact precomputed distributions for designation, grade, geography, date, source and risk fields
limitations: Not every field applies to every category or year

evidence: Source layers and annual event types project to explicit record and heritage types
Official rich page, source feature, annual workbook and frozen geometry resources
Boundary membership, HAR-to-NHLE and annual-continuity assertions carry predicates, evidence and authority
limitations: Annual continuity is visibly normalized, not source-declared

evidence: The Links plane projects governed relationship types and source/target routes from the same filtered record set
limitations: A link is not evidence of legal effect unless its assertion metadata says so

evidence: Designation, amendment and annual register dates drive the same filtered result set
limitations: Different categories use different statutory date meanings

evidence: Source geometry shards, exact scope memberships and labelled polygon representative points
The Narrative plane explains how every view remains a projection of one evidence-bound query and facet state
limitations: Generated narrative explains the evaluation and does not reproduce Historic England rich-page prose

evidence: Selected record exposes source values, normalization, identifiers, geometry, quality and links
Snapshot, request, source object or workbook row, relationship evidence and assertion labels
limitations: Source provenance is not an independent factual audit

evidence: The local real-browser faithful journey preserves one query and facet state through view changes, Back, Forward and reload
Keyboard-reachable controls, semantic labels, live result summaries, reduced-motion behavior and HVR001/HVR002 viewport evidence
limitations: Automated checks complement but do not replace assistive-technology user testing

evidence: The clean local site build rendered 239 reading pages, resolved 4,134 internal page references and passed the 1 GB GitHub Pages size gate
Five release artifact planes have rooted digests, and all eight Explorer presentation views passed the local faithful journey
limitations: Local build and journey evidence do not prove public availability
The exact GitHub Pages URLs remain a terminal post-deployment gate
Live source URLs can change after the recorded observation time

publication_boundary: The faithful corpus is an evaluation projection, not a legal register; the synthetic bundle is separately identified, default-off and excluded from faithful counts and search.
